d:
US investors return from the holiday with a rally in equity futures as a tech recovery gains momentum. EU leaders cut budget talks short after failing to negotiate a long-term funding plan. Shoppers prepare for Black Friday as retailers navigate higher fuel costs and consumers tightening their belts. Marija Veitmane of State Street joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss the stock rebound, and Nadia Martin Wiggen of Svelland Capital takes a look at the oil market as attacks in the Middle East escalates.
